traditional_use: Used to collect, carry, store and serve milk.
story_so: Dhiil waxaa diiwaanka lagu aqoonsaday shayga lambarkiisu yahay 1. Diiwaanku wuxuu ku tilmaamayaa weel dheer oo dhuuban oo laga sameeyey fiilooyin dhir la tolay, laguna qurxiyey xariijimo midabbo leh. Waxaa loo isticmaali jiray ururinta, qaadista, kaydinta iyo bixinta caanaha.
story_en: Dhiil is identified as artifact 1 in the supplied inventory. The inventory describes it as a tall, narrow woven vessel decorated with colorful horizontal bands and a carrying cord. It is made from woven plant fibers and was traditionally used to collect, carry, store and serve milk.

passages.text: The inventory describes Dhiil as a tall, narrow woven vessel decorated with colorful horizontal bands and a carrying cord.
The inventory lists the material as woven plant fibers.
The inventory states that Dhiil was used to collect, carry, store and serve milk.

passages.text: Diiwaanku wuxuu Dhiil ku tilmaamayaa weel dheer oo dhuuban oo la tolay, laguna qurxiyey xariijimo midabbo leh iyo xarig lagu qaado.
Diiwaanka wuxuu sheegayaa in Dhiil laga sameeyey fiilooyin dhir la tolay.
Diiwaanku wuxuu sheegayaa in Dhiil loo isticmaali jiray ururinta, qaadista, kaydinta iyo bixinta caanaha.
